_README: Hand verdicts on commits, keyed by SHORT sha (12 chars) as the ledger emits it.
These WIN over the heuristic and survive every regeneration of the ledger.
Use them for the two cases the fingerprinter cannot decide on its own:
1. a commit deliberately superseded by later work (record WHY, with evidence)
2. a commit whose fingerprints are structurally underivable (pure revert, etc.)
Allowed verdicts: intact | LOST | off-build-line | superseded | accepted-loss |
Never set a verdict to 'superseded' without naming the thing that supersedes it.
Never leave a LOST override standing on a durability claim you have not re-checked:
`git -C <repo> for-each-ref --contains <sha>` is one command and the fingerprinter
now runs it for you (auto_verdict=off-build-line when a REMOTE ref still has it).

5192458dcc30.note: PN71 06-19 'clamp thinking_token_budget below max_tokens so cut-mid-think never yields empty content'. The clamp (`if max_tokens is not None and _pn71_ttb >= max_tokens: self.thinking_token_budget = max(1, max_tokens - _pn71_grace)`) is GONE from fixes/patch_pn71_reasoning_alias.py, and PN71_ANSWER_GRACE moved 1024 -> 512. So this is a documented, deliberate trade, not a silent loss. 80792e9a4f76.note: vllm-build: our 07-03 draft of #47574 (zero new KV blocks for quantized sliding-window hybrid caches). All three symbols it introduced (has_block_dropping_layers, has_quantized_kv_cache, needs_quantized_reuse_zeroing) are absent from cherry-max, which is why the fingerprinter flags it. NOT our loss: #47574 merged upstream as 8ce53a616 on 07-20 and that commit is an ancestor of our base 0ba2aa35. Upstream's merged form is DIFFERENT code (gates on has_mixed_precision_kv_cache, i.e. >1 distinct (dtype, kv_quant_mode)) and is strictly narrower than our draft - a uniformly-quantized sliding-window cache zeroes under ours but not under upstream's. Inert for us either way: Qwen3.6 is hybrid-mamba, so has_mamba_layers forces zeroing regardless. Recorded in vllm-build BUILD-NOTES.md.
